listing.name: Rockstar Games Presents Table Tennis — Table Tennis Recomp (bartando)
listing.summary: The project reaches a match on Apple Silicon and PS5, with tested LAN crossplay. Timing acceleration, shader stutter and rally-correctness issues remain. Windows has had less testing. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 ISO with default.xex for title 545407DF, without a title update. This guide does not specify the exact supported hash or revision; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The recorded review found a Windows ZIP, macOS DMG and native PS5 package. Setup extracts your own ISO. macOS targets Apple Silicon with Vulkan/MoltenVK; Windows targets x64 with Vulkan and AVX2.

warnings: The project reaches a match on Apple Silicon and PS5, with tested LAN crossplay. Timing acceleration, shader stutter and rally-correctness issues remain. Windows has had less testing.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
